description: This source file implements network interface allocation functions for the Android 'cuttlefish' project, including creating default network configurations and allocating network interfaces via a socket connection to a daemon.

methods.name: StrForInstance
methods.description: Generates a string with a prefix and a zero-padded number, used for naming network interfaces.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Creates a default configuration of network interfaces with specified numbering.

methods.name: AllocateNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Allocates network interfaces by communicating with a daemon over a socket, and returns the configuration if successful.
